ns2:course.label: Sequential Design
ns2:course.description: Introduces and explores the structure and manipulation of time and space as a context for communication, with emphasis on design using type, image, sound, and motion with computer-based hypermedia. Prerequisite: Junior standing in graphic design or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Junior standing in graphic design or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
